title: TRIED: Truly Innovative and Effective AI Detection Benchmark, developed by WITNESS.
reasoning: The paper introduces the TRIED Benchmark to evaluate the effectiveness and fairness of AI detection tools (primarily for deepfakes and synthetic audio/video). While the benchmark includes criteria for 'ethical AI principles' and 'fairness' in tool development and data collection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific systems of moral/ethical reasoning as its core task.
